about: A guest gives an address that already has an account here: the right code signs them in (collective-belfry docs/guests.md, "An address that has an account: the right code signs you in", 2026-11-19; canvas onboarding/guest-code). The device makes a NEW session key (the guest session key stays bound to the guest account) and sends its PUBLIC key with the code: POST /api/v1/guest/save/verify, NIP-98 by the guest as before. `request`: what is typed and the body sent (email and code trimmed; name only when the sheet asked for one; session_key = 64 lower-case hex; client = the app's own id). `answers`: each HTTP answer and `next`, what the app does: signed_in = drop the guest session and its key, store the new session (bunker_url + the new key's secret) like any sign-in, open `channel` (null: home) and say "Signed in as <address>" (address = nip05 when it is name@<domain>, else the e-mail typed) for 3 s, no second code; saved = the guest is saved as before (no account had the address); sign_in_instead = the old path: the account holds its own key or the server is older, sign in with the address (moved says whether the channel went to that account); same_code = the code is not spent: make another session key and send the same code again; new_key_new_code = make another session key and ask for a new code; new_code = ask for a new code (the code is spent); wrong_code / expired / too_many / not_guest as before. A 200 with signed_in true whose bunker_url is not a bunker address or whose pubkey is not 64 hex is never stored: `failed`.

answers.name: the address is another account's: signed in
signed in, no channel to open, no nip05: the e-mail typed is the address said
signed in, a nip05 of another domain is not said
nobody had the address: the guest is saved, as before
signed_in without a bunker address is never stored
signed_in with a pubkey that is not a key is never stored
taken: the account holds its own key, or an older server

body.message: This address already has an account here.

answers.name: invalid session key: the code is not spent
the session key is linked to another account
the signer did not answer: the code is spent
